calibration.qv4h_join: panel wide_panel_4h_v2ext / meta_newprod_v4 qvk -> expm1(clip(qvk,0,30))*48; anchors after 2026-08-31 20Z (15367 of 47135 rows) use the symbol's median qv4h over the last 42 panel rows = DECLARED EXTRAPOLATION
calibration.maker_share_excludes: order_type=protective_flatten (14-17% of filled notional; stop-loss / watchdog events on 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-09, not steady-state rebalancing)
calibration.fee_note: measured 1.90/4.76 bps vs the deployed model's 1.80/4.50: the deployed value assumes 100% BNB-discounted fees; realised BNB coverage is ~48% of fill notional
calibration.impact_form: I_bps = K * sigma_4h_bps * sqrt(|trade|*G/qv4h), sigma_4h from meta y4 per name, G=230000 USDT (live NAV 114,949 x constant_leverage_2.00, daily_nav.jsonl 2026-09-11)
calibration.impact_extrapolation: participation in the replay is 9.8e-6 (tier0) to 4.9e-4 (tier2); at that size impact is BELOW the noise floor of the live fills, so K is NOT fitted. Tier constants are a LINEARISATION valid at G=$230k; impact scales as sqrt(G), so K=2 == 4x gross and K=3 == 9x gross at the same K=1 coefficient.
calibration.replay_traded_range: the device trades only qv4h>=2.5e5 (log10=5.4); the two least-liquid live deciles (log10 qv4h 4.71-5.40) are OUTSIDE the replay's traded set
